deadline.value: For funding consideration, the Fall assistantship deadline is March 1, 2027; the Fall application deadline is June 30, 2027 (domestic) or May 15, 2027 (international).

gre_general.value: The program page says GRE scores are optional and must be sent officially if submitted. The graduate school's doctoral list says no GRE is required.
gre_general.quote: If submitting Graduate Record Examination (GRE) a score, official scores must be sent directly from the test administrator to the Graduate School

gre_subject.value: The page does not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a faculty supervisor's agreement is needed.

funding.value: Most graduate assistantships are awarded competitively on academic merit; the program page gives no separate funding rule.
funding.quote: are awarded on a competitive basis, with academic merit being the primary consideration

entry_route.value: Applicants must meet master's-level admission requirements; a bachelor's degree with 72 hours beyond it is also accepted.
entry_route.quote: applicants to the PH.D. program in Mathematics must meet all requirements for admission at the master’s level

notes: Covers applied mathematics, pure mathematics and statistics concentrations.
name: Mathematics, Ph.D.
